caption: A log is rolled off the back of a trailer onto a slight downhill slope and rolls down to the bottom.

sa.check: A log is rolled off the back of a trailer.
It lands on a downhill slope.
It rolls down to the bottom.
The slope is slight rather than steep.
The log leaves the trailer first and the roll down follows.

pc.expect: The log drops from the trailer to the ground and then goes downhill, quicker as it goes, coming to rest at the bottom or against something.
pc.fail: The log rolls uphill; or it stops on the open slope with nothing in its way; or it hangs in the air after leaving the trailer.

pc.expect: It turns about its length as it rolls and keeps roughly a straight line down the slope.
pc.fail: The log slides down end-on without turning; or it turns sharply on the open slope with nothing touching it; or it bounces higher than the trailer bed.

pc.expect: Once on the ground nothing but the slope moves the log, and at the bottom it stays.
pc.fail: The log speeds up after reaching the flat; or it sets off again after coming to rest; or it changes direction with nothing touching it.

pc.expect: The log stays a rigid cylinder and the ground takes the impact.
pc.fail: The log bends as it rolls; or it splashes where it lands; or the ground ripples under it.

pc.expect: One log and one trailer keep their number and shape.
pc.fail: The log vanishes or a second one appears; or it passes through the trailer or the ground; or it turns into another object.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The log's bark, the trailer and the slope stay the same.
pc.fail: The log changes colour or length; or the trailer changes shape between frames; or the slope rearranges.
